knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "HARTZ Physical Therapy is a locally owned independent outpatient physical therapy clinic with five convenient locations in Lancaster County. We specialize in orthopedic rehabilitation, aquatic therapy, post-surgery, sports injuries, and vestibular therapy. Unparalleled patient outcomes and an average Net Promoter Score of 95 reflect our unwavering commitment to our patients. It is your choice where to go to physical therapy. Experience the Difference HARTZ PT can make in your recovery."

posts.description:
For 25 years, HARTZ Physical Therapy has been more than a clinic—it’s been a place where people feel seen, supported, and truly cared for.

We believe in hands-on, one-on-one care and building real relationships. No rushed appointments. No cookie-cutter plans. Just personalized therapy, passionate people, and a heart for the community.

As we celebrate 25 years, this video reflects on what makes our physical therapy practice different.  It’s not just what we do, but how we do it.

Watch our story. Feel the difference. 
#25YearsStrong #HARTZPT #PTwithPurpose #WhatSetsUsApart

Mackenzie in our Lititz office is a certified ASTYM Therapist, which is fantastic for breaking down scar tissue, regenerating healthy soft tissue and improving movement...feels pretty good too!  

#physicaltherapy #astymtherapy #healing

No Waitlists. Just Progress.
If you or a loved one is recovering from a stroke, brain injury, Parkinson’s, or other neurological condition—getting the right care now makes all the difference.

At HARTZ Physical Therapy Lancaster West, our experienced neuro PT and OT team is ready when you are. With no waitlists, you can start your personalized rehabilitation plan without delay.

 • Outpatient Neurological Physical Therapy
 • Specialized Neurological Occupational Therapy
 • Collaborative, compassionate care for you & your caregivers

Call today to schedule your first appointment—we’re here to help you move forward.

🎉 25 YEARS of HARTZ PT 🎉

✅ Thousands of patients
✅ 6 locations
✅ $350,000+ given back
✅ One amazing community 💙

From recovery stories to color runs, golf outings to food drives — it’s been 25 years of movement, mission & momentum 

And we’re just getting started.
#HARTZ25 #PTwithHeart #StrongerTogether #25YearsStrong #TikTokPT #25thanniversary

👋 New Team Member in Lititz!

Please help us welcome Dain, our newest Physical Therapist at HARTZ PT – Lititz! A recent LVC graduate, Dain is starting out in orthopedics and is especially passionate about helping patients with neurological conditions.

He’s also an avid mountain biker and—fun fact—is married to Celia, one of our PTs in the Ephrata office!

Stop in and say hello 👋

She brings nearly 3 years of experience, including time at an inpatient rehab hospital, and is passionate about personalized care for patients recovering from strokes, brain injuries, and more.

We’re excited to have her on our NeuroRehabilitation team! 💙

Did you know that millions of people silently struggle with pelvic floor disorders each year? May is Pelvic Pain Awareness Month, a time to shine a light on an often-overlooked aspect of our well-being. Pelvic health affects everyone—regardless of age or gender. From incontinence and pelvic pain to postpartum recovery and sexual health, these issues are common and treatable, yet too often go undiscussed.

We’re proud to have two experienced pelvic health physical therapists on staff, Celia Vallie, DPT in our Ephrata office and Jennifer Graham, DPT in our Lititz office.  Both are dedicated to helping individuals regain confidence, strength, and comfort through personalized care.  Call either to learn more about how they can help.
#pelvicpainawareness #pelvicphysicaltherapy #pelvicfloor
